scope_notes: Native macOS Chop v0.1, user task and DESIGN comparison. macOS26.5.2/CI15; macOS14 physical, full VoiceOver/all IMEs and hardware wheel are explicitly outside verified combinations. Shell/TUI VT styling and standard OS chrome are distinguished from app-owned labels. cmux is technical/feature inspiration, not a visual pixel reference. User correction 2026-10-14 adds R-DEFAULT canvas screenshot as a visual/state reference; first shell + three empty plus panes is mandatory at default entry. Previous main gate lacked that condition; its historical ledger is retained.
